restriction_note: 61 archived cells x an 8-item floor would be 488 items, outside the pre-registered [150,200] window, so the PAID re-scoring is restricted to the 19 load-bearing stages that P1-P5 quote. All 61 cells were regenerated and their cache-hit statistics are reported; only re-scoring is restricted.
partial_note: EVERY PARTIAL item in the frame is taken -- the oversampling is maximal by construction. If the achieved PARTIAL fraction is below the 20% target it is because the archived primary judge almost never emitted PARTIAL, which is itself a finding about rubric B: its three-way label set behaves as a two-way one.
frame_definition: every regenerated item whose (prompt, response) hits the archived judge-cache sha256 key, i.e. whose text is PROVEN byte-identical to the text the archived judge read
